description: On run failure (agent error, timeout, push rejection, worktree assertion failure), patch the status comment to Status: failed with a short user-facing summary (no secrets, no raw logs) and the retry instruction ('To retry, post a new comment: otto retry'). The agent prompt instructs the agent to return only a short summary suitable for public posting. Otto truncates any runner output to 500 characters before including it.
title: Failure reporting and retry instructions in status comments
